## Not Assessable Areas

The following knowledge areas could not be evaluated because PMM MCP v1 does
not yet expose the required data. These are not findings — they are scope
limitations of this audit version.

| Area | Data needed to assess |
|---|---|
| Cost Management | Budget baseline, actual cost to date (pending MCP expansion) |
| Schedule detail | Task list, milestone dates, dependencies (pending PRO-148) |
| Procurement | Vendor contracts, SLAs, procurement plan |

To assess these areas in future audits, upload relevant documents (budget plans,
schedules, contracts) to the PMM knowledge base, or wait for MCP tool expansion.

## Audit Methodology

This report was generated by `pmm-pmi-auditor` using PMI PMBOK 7th Edition as
the reference framework. Data sources: PMM project context (MCP), risk register
(MCP), and project knowledge base (semantic search). Findings are evidence-based
and cite specific data points. Areas without sufficient data are marked Not
Assessable rather than assumed compliant or non-compliant.

This report is a proposal pending human review in the PMM inbox. No project data
was modified.
